evaluation.justice: Strict motor-only access, no consideration for pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, extremely low travel equity for vulnerable groups.
evaluation.safety: Full isolation guardrails, wide lanes, excellent sight distance, standardized traffic markings, high overall driving safety.
evaluation.livability: No residential or leisure functions, purely transit-oriented, extremely low livability.
evaluation.sustainability: Large area of natural green belts on both sides, good ecological carbon sequestration capacity.
evaluation.aesthetics: Open linear landscape, neat roadside green vegetation, wide distant sky view.
evaluation.comfort: Wide and flat road surface, small driving jitter, affected by high-speed wind noise.
evaluation.walkability: Pedestrians are strictly prohibited, no walking function at all.
